role: support-only input-resolution probe; no test image or test label
support_selection: manifest seed 0, k2; each query image held out from memory

input.tile_stitch: each tile independently DINO-encoded at 448 edge to 32 x 32; concatenate to 64 x 64
input.backbone: existing v14 export make_extractor('dino'), frozen, no new download

evaluation.mask: same 1024 x 1024 renderer mask for all arms
evaluation.ap: pixel average precision on the original mask
evaluation.random_area_ap: mask positive-pixel prevalence; large-sample/random-ranking reference, not exact finite-sample AP expectation
evaluation.normal_fp: p99 of memory-image LOO score map; clean/nuisance all pixels, synthetic outside mask
evaluation.memory: only the other support image in the same category; no query image cells
